critical_code_review_comments: FounderPage.jsx correctly uses history.replaceState to strip ?key= before any redirect — secret never lands in browser history. Good.
Backend /api/founder/auth uses secrets.compare_digest — constant-time compare. Good.
Backend uses fail-shut 503 when FOUNDER_KEY env is empty (not wide-open). Good.
Idempotency: existing founder user reuses portal_token rather than minting fresh one each call — verified token stable across calls.
PreviewPage is fully read-only with toast-based locked CTAs — no real backend write/state mutation triggered by /preview at all. Good.
Mobile /founder shows a ~3px horizontal overflow at 390x844 (max-w-md card). Cosmetic only; no UX impact. Could tighten px-4 → px-3 if perfection desired.
